mapper.select: SELECT id, config_key AS configKey, config_value AS configValue, description, updated_by AS updatedBy, update_time AS updateTime FROM sys_config WHERE config_key = #{configKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_config (config_key, config_value, updated_by, update_time) VALUES (#{configKey}, #{configValue}, #{updatedBy}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE config_value = #{configValue}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, update_time = NOW()
